title: Springfield Radio Module Catalog
description: Index of installable per-radio module packages for the Ham Radio desktop app (ADR 0009 schema version 3, ADR 0012 trust fields). Each entry is one radio zip on GitHub Releases. schemaVersion stays 3 so @springfield/ham-radio-registry 2.x still parses the document; trust fields are additive and ignored by that registry.

schemaVersion.description: Catalog format version. The app rejects unsupported versions. Trust fields did not bump this value.

package.description: Logical package name for developers (e.g. @springfield/radio-module-kenwood-th-f6). Not an npm install coordinate. Registry 2.x requires this shape for every tier.

name.description: Radio display name from config id.name.

tier.description: Trust tier. official means the zip is published by springfield-ham-radio. community means a reviewed outside driver, shown as Community, by <publisher>. Omitted means official. Unverified is a file install and is not a catalog tier.

publisher.description: Display name in Community, by <publisher>. Required when tier is community. Optional for official. This is not a GitHub login or an npm scope.

config.description: Path of the config inside the zip.

minApiVersion.description: Minimum @springfield/ham-radio-api version required by this radio config.

downloadUrl.description: HTTPS GitHub Releases URL of the per-radio JSON zip. Official entries are assets from springfield-ham-radio. Community entries are assets from another owner, pinned to that release until a reviewed pull request.

integrity.description: SHA-256 of the published zip as sha256:<hex>. Repeated-nibble digests (including sha256:000…0) are placeholders and are rejected.

deprecated.description: Present when the driver is broken or the maintainer has not responded for about 90 days. The entry stays in the catalog until a later pull request removes it. Omit the property when the driver is not deprecated.

date.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the entry was marked deprecated.
